💧 Water Intelligence — Setup

Configure this board's complaints ingest, then run it. Settings are saved for your tenant; the nightly schedule keeps it current.
Finding the complaints driver…

1Source — your complaints export

Upload your grievance/complaints CSV. (S1 cap: 25 MB — use a recent export or a sample; the full historical file loads via the CLI for now.)

2Mapping — taxonomy & admin hierarchy

Paste your board's crosswalk (raw label → canonical category) and admin-column mapping as JSON. S2 will replace this with a visual editor + ✨ Auto-map (AI).

3Run & verify

Runs the ingest once now (idempotent — only new/changed complaints are written).
